about: Verification rows of the DFlash v1 drafter (confidence of the argmax over its top-16, softmax with tau 1.5) for Gemma 4 26B-A4B 4-bit: lab-dev rowscal (2026-10-29) with Platt per depth 0, 1, 2, >= 3 on 14 real agent turns (pi with this model, 1,912-10,848 prompt tokens) x 256 greedy tokens (920 rounds, 3426 samples); cost with prompts-gemma4-26b/512,4K,16K,32K: ms per round (drafter included) with k = 2..8 rows trimmed on the GPU, with isotonic regression. Only the 26B-A4B has a default drafter in this family.
